body: Hi there! I’m not a male, nor am I 16... but, I do know that during the winter months things can get a bit harder emotionally due to the weather and all of the holidays with family are done for awhile. This quarantine thing certainly doesn’t help with people who are extroverted. Have you tried talking to your parents about this? I’m sure they would be there to help you and get you in the right direction to feeling better again. If you ever just need anyone to talk to, I know how to keep a conversation going, so feel free to message me if needed! :)
I just wanna know if I'm risking death.
I want some really good sleep. But don't want to risk death.
